about_the_game:
Mini-Market Simulator VR

Welcome to Mini-Market Simulator VR, the ultimate virtual reality experience where you can live out your entrepreneurial dreams by running and expanding your very own mini-market in VR! Immerse yourself in a bustling retail environment where every decision you make shapes your path to becoming a successful market.

Game Features

Experience a fully immersive 3D mini market in virtual reality. Use VR controllers to handle items, scan products, and manage tasks, all with realistic interactions.

Immersive and realistic environment

Interactive VR Gameplay

Engage with highly interactive VR gameplay systems, where you can perform a variety of tasks such as checking out customers, managing inventory, and dealing with store events. Each task is designed to be hands-on, utilizing the capabilities of VR to make every action feel tangible and rewarding.

Customized Store Layout

Customize your store layout to reflect your style and strategy. Rearrange shelves, displays, and counters to optimize the shopping experience and increase efficiency. Tailor the store’s appearance and functionality to suit different customer preferences and business goals, creating a unique and personalized mini market.

Expanding Products and Furnitures

Enjoy an expanding library of store products and furniture. Regular updates introduce new items and decorations, allowing you to keep your mini market fresh and appealing. From seasonal products to unique furniture pieces, continually enhance your store and keep customers coming back for more.

Cleaning Gameplay

Maintain cleanliness in your store with the cleaning gameplay feature. Sweep floors, wipe down walls from graffiti, and take out the trash to ensure a pleasant shopping environment. Cleanliness affects customer satisfaction and store reputation, adding another layer of realism and management to the game.

Mini-Games

Have fun with extra mini-games, including a basketball mini-game where you can take a break and shoot some hoops. Look forward to more mini-games we plan on adding in future updates to provide variety and additional entertainment within the game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.3 Ghz CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3, HTC Vive, Windows Mixed Reality, Pico, and Valve Index
